meta.name: aed:animated-numbers
meta.description: Optional. Activates auto-promotion of plain numbers within `data-auto-scope` so they animate without per-element markup.

data-auto-scope.description: CSS selector identifying elements to auto-promote (e.g. '.hero-stats .stat-number').

data-default-duration.description: Fallback animation duration in ms applied to auto-promoted elements.

data.description: Per-element controls. The element's text is replaced with the animating value when it scrolls into view.

data-aed-count-decimals.description: Decimal places. Inferred from `count-to` if omitted.

data-aed-count-separator.description: Thousands separator (e.g. ','). Auto-inferred from existing element text.

data-aed-count-prefix.description: String prepended to the value (e.g. '$'). Auto-inferred.

data-aed-count-replay.description: Replay the animation every time the element re-enters the viewport.
